findings.finding: The upgraded FY guide implies a sharp Q4 slowdown that ALK's own comps do not require: FY 16-17% l.c. on a DKK 6,312m base after H1 +18% implies H2 +14-16% l.c., and with Q3 near the H1 pace Q4 must grow only about 10-13% l.c., while Q4 2025 International tablets fell 11% on Japan phasing (an easy comp); ALK has raised guidance at Aug 2025, Nov 2025, May 2026, Aug 2026 and Oct 2026, so a narrowing to the top end on 17 Nov is a plausible in-window upside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Report days with a guide raise: Q3 2025 +11.5% (2025-11-13), Q1 2026 +7.0% (2026-05-04); Q2 2026 with only a bottom-end lift and unchanged margin -6.5% (2026-08-20); FY2025 first guide 11-15% -2.5% (2026-02-20). The Oct 7 upgrade itself: +4.7% next session.

The original 2026 financial calendar (Danish 'Finanskalender for regnskabsåret 2026', 22 Dec 2025) listed '18. november 2026: Delårsrapport 9 måneder (Q3) 2026'; English carries the same, so the move to the 17th is visible in both languages.
